implementation: Blue Coat Systems, Software Cryptographic Module
description: The cryptographic module provides cryptographic services for Solera DeepSee Software, a security intelligence and analytics solution that creates a complete record of network traffic. The module is a shared library that links to Solera DeepSee components and is executed on a GPC or on a supported VM hypervisor.
